title: PartySystem
description: A classic party system with ptp!
body:
PartyPlugin is a lightweight yet powerful party and teleportation system for your Minecraft server.

========== FEATURES ==========

✓ Complete party management (create, invite, join, leave, disband)

✓ Party PvP toggle - protect your teammates!

✓ Party member list with online status

✓ TPA system with accept/deny commands

✓ SPECIAL: /ptp command - teleport to party members instantly (5s delay, no accept needed!)

✓ Teleport cancellation on movement/damage

✓ Fully configurable (config.yml)

✓ No dependencies required!

========== COMMANDS ==========

/party create     - Create a new party

/party invite     - Invite a player to your party

/party join       - Join a party

/party leave      - Leave your current party

/party list       - List all party members

/party pvp        - Toggle party PvP (leader only)

/party disband    - Disband the party (leader only)

/tpa <player>     - Request teleport to a player

/tpaccept         - Accept teleport request

/tpdeny           - Deny teleport request

/ptp <player>     - Teleport to party member instantly!

========== PERMISSIONS ==========

party.* - All commands (default: true)

========== SUPPORT ==========

If you encounter any issues, join our Discord: https://discord.gg/t965FT7eRU
